additional_info.subject: ID0418689-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R8 170002447] Problem on DC2 CRM:02679000105
additional_info.body:
Hello Riccardo,
Please update this charger to v6.1.3 or let me know if I can do it. The tests to be done here are exactly the same as in ID0418687 but instead of XD10 it's XD16:
Remove the colored cables from XD16 (blue, orange, white and violet) and measure between:
Blue and Orange must be 1kOhm
White and Violet must be 1kOhm
If both are 1kOhm, we insert them back in the XD10 and remove from the KF14 input CCS-B IN (J5) PT1 and PT2, and measure to the respective Orange-PT1 and Violet-PT2.
If both are 1kOhm please try the following:
Replace the connector in the KF14:
Usually in these KF11/KF12/KF14, you have a spare grey connector without any connections.
If we see 1kOhm still, then we need to replace the StateMonitor.
Please let me know once it's in v6.1.3
Thanks!
best regards,
Francisco
